## Summary

Describe the user-visible or maintenance change and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] User-facing changes are recorded under `Unreleased` in
      `packages/vscode/CHANGELOG.md`
- [ ] Generated data changes are deterministic and identify their source
- [ ] New third-party text, images, or binaries have documented redistribution
      permission or licence
- [ ] No credentials, `.env` files, or unrelated generated artifacts are
      included
